verdict.rationale: Check documents an official Check MCP Server that works with any MCP-compatible client. It can be connected as a hosted remote URL using OAuth or an API key, supports a read-only mode, and can be self-hosted with configurable toolsets. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Check MCP Server works with any MCP-compatible client, including: Claude Desktop, Claude Code (CLI), Cursor, GitHub Copilot (VS Code), ChatGPT
Connect directly from your AI client with just a URL — no repo to clone, no Python to install.
OAuth suits people working in an AI client; an API key suits agents running on your own servers with no browser to drive.
By appending the `read_only=true` query parameter to the end of the URL, you can force the MCP to operate in read-only mode.
Run the Check MCP Server locally for full control over your configuration, access control, and environment.
